column1: This dataset provides a comprehensive view of retail operations, encompassing sales, inventory, and supply chain activities. It includes detailed point-of-sale transaction data, customer information, and product details, enabling in-depth sales analysis and customer segmentation. The dataset also contains information on stock levels, stock movements, purchase orders, and transfers, facilitating inventory management and supply chain optimization. Supplier details are included, supporting supplier relationship management. Sales forecasts are available, enabling predictive analysis and informed decision-making. The data can be used to optimize operations, improve customer satisfaction, and drive business growth.
